31
RAJYA  SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Monday, August 8, 2011/Sravana 17, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries: Coal; Consumer Affairs, Food and Public Distribution; Corporate
Affairs; Earth Sciences; Information and Broadcasting; Law and Justice;
Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises; Mines; Minority Affairs;
New and Renewable Energy; Parliamentary Affairs; Power;
Science and Technology; Water Resources)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Disturbance in frequencies of
channels
†*101. SHRI ISHWARLAL
SHANKARLAL JAIN: Will the Minister
of INFORMA TION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether there are frequent changes
in the frequencies of channels being shown
through Direct-to-Home (DTH) by satellite
of Doordarshan;
(b) whether Government proposes to
bring more channels within the ambit of
DTH;
(c) whether Marathi IBN-Lokmat
channel which was earlier being shown
through DTH, is no longer available on
DTH for many months; and
(d) if so, the reasons therefor?
Scheme for minority dominated
districts of Madhya Pradesh
†*102. SHRI PRABHAT JHA: Will the
Minister of MINORITY AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a proposal
of Madhya Pradesh Government pertaining
to development scheme for minority
dominated districts is pending with the
Ministry;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether the Ministry has taken any
decision thereon; and
(d) if not, by when a decision would be
taken?
Achievement of RGGVY target
*103. SHRI KANWAR DEEP SINGH:
Will the Minister of POWER be pleased to
state:
(a) whether the targets fixed for
electrification of villages during each of the
last three years under the Rajiv Gandhi
Grameen Vidyutikaran Yojana (RGGVY)
have been achieved in various States
including Jharkhand;
(b) if so, the details thereof, State-wise;
and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?

32
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Allocation of coal blocks to private
companies
*104. SHRI PRAKASH JAV ADEKAR:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) how many coal blocks were allocated
to private companies during the period 2006
to 2009;
(b) the details of such coal blocks,
including coal reserves, allocated to private
companies;
(c) the reasons for such allocations and
since when the Bill to auction coal blocks
is pending in the Parliament;
(d) whether all these companies have
established production units in steel/
cement/power sectors; and
(e) if not, the reasons therefor?
Progress of Panchnad dam
†*105. SHRI GANGA CHARAN : Will
the Minister of WA TER RESOURCES  be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of the progress made with
regard to the  project of Panchnad dam
proposed by the State Governments of
Uttar Pradesh and Madhya Pradesh;
(b) whether this project can be included
in the special package given to the
Bundelkhand region; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Corruption in CIL
*106. SHRI DHIRAJ PRASAD SAHU:
Will the Minister of COAL be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has received
any complaints of alleged corruption
prevailing in the Coal India Ltd. (CIL);
(b) if so, the details thereof including
the number of complaints received during
the last three years and the current year,
subsidiary-wise and year-wise;
(c) whether Government has conducted
any investigation into these complaints;
(d) if so, the outcome thereof,
subsidiary-wise;
(e) the details of the officers against
whom charges were framed by the
investigating agencies and those punished
or exonerated as a result thereof,
subsidiary-wise; and
(f) the effective measures taken by
Government in this regard?
Joint Group of Experts on Flood
Management
*107. SHRI TARINI KANTA ROY:
Will the Minister of W A TER RESOURCES
be pleased to refer to the answer to Starred
Question 371 given in the Rajya Sabha on
19 August, 2010 and state:
(a) the details of the follow-up action
taken after the meeting of the Joint Group
of Experts on Flood Management between
Government of India and the Royal
Government of Bhutan; and
(b) the details of the steps taken to save
the people of North Bengal who are affected
by floods every year?
Availability of channels on DTH
†*108. SHRI RAVI SHANKAR
PRASAD: Will the Minister of
INFORMATION AND
BROADCASTING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that under the
prevailing circumstances, a common
television viewer has been left at the mercy
of Direct-to-Home (DTH) operators;

33
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if not, Government's reaction
thereto;
(c) whether it is also a fact that a
common viewer is forced to watch such
channels for which he does not pay;
(d) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(e) whether, while implementing the
existing system, Government had assured
that the common viewer would watch only
those channels which he would opt for?

centres

MUNGEKAR: Will the Minister of
